name: VSM magnetometry: M-T from 5 K to 300 K and M-H isotherms up to 9 T
plain_name: Measure a sample's magnetization with a vibrating sample magnetometer
description: Measure magnetization versus temperature (5-300 K) and versus field up to 9 T with a vibrating sample magnetometer, as in the Zintl-phase study on a PPMS DynaCool VSM.

sources.citation: Advancing Heteroanionicity in Zintl Phases: Crystal Structures, Thermoelectric and Magnetic Properties of Two Quaternary Semiconducting Arsenide Oxides, Eu8Zn2As6O and Eu14Zn5As12O
Rare-earth doped BiFe0.95Mn0.05O3 nanoparticles for potential hyperthermia applications

reported_conditions.as_printed: crushed crystals in a polyethylene capsule on a holder rod

requirements.rationale: The M-T measurement spanned 5-300 K (paper's range; user confirms).
M-H isotherms were swept to 90 kOe (9 T); both procedures reached 9 T.
Both procedures used the PPMS DynaCool VSM option.
Optional: the second procedure swept temperature at 5 K/min.

params.name: target_field
params.description: Highest field of the M-H isotherms

params.name: field_ramp_time_budget
params.description: Time you allow for ramping the magnet to the target field (optional check)

coupled.rationale: Optional: reports whether the documented charging rate reaches the target field within your time budget.

missing_information: sample mass and dimensions (not stated in either procedure)
confirmation_note: Profile author reviewed the requirements on 2026-10-31; users must re-confirm edited values.
